what_happened: Third Oracle dispatch (ses_ef691ac84ffeEXlXEBzFAFFl57 / ora-3) failed with the identical error 'Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media'. This attempt contained NO file paths and NO read instructions -- all prompt material was inlined in the message. Oracle therefore cannot open a session at all in this environment; the failure is systemic to the oracle specialist, not caused by prompt content.
root_cause: Oracle session baseline context exceeds the compaction limit before any tool use.
what_i_did_wrong: After the second failure I should have inferred the failure was systemic rather than content-related and stopped.
impact: No independent prompt-neutrality review available from Oracle. Fell back to (a) an alternative reviewer specialist and (b) an empirical check on the produced assessment for signs of leading.
preventive: Two identical environmental failures on a specialist = stop retrying that specialist. Switch specialist or switch verification method. Oracle escalation is optional for tasks outside Rule 11.1 mandatory triggers; this task matched none, so absence of Oracle does not block acceptance.
